title: jmap-chat-spec: field attributes disagree with /set method text
description:
JMAP-x2gd.87 classified SetObject lists from spec text. Several chat/vtc drafts mark a field with no attribute although its /set section never lets a client set it (server-set in effect) or only on create (immutable in effect). The crate now follows the method text; the drafts should say the same in the field attributes so RFC 8620 §1.1 readers agree.

draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 at 6c38e2f:
- Chat members, spaceId, categoryId, position, topic, slowModeSeconds, permissionOverrides: no attribute; Chat/set never accepts them (addMembers / Space/set addChannels, updateChannels). Suggest 'server-set' or a note that Chat/set does not set them.
- Space roles, members, categories, uncategorizedChannelIds: no attribute; Space/set changes them only via semantic keys.
- ChatContact endpoints: no attribute; 'create accepts only identity', 'update supports: blocked, displayName'. displayName/blocked are update-only.
- Message attachments, actions, replyTo, threadRootId, sentAt: no attribute; accepted on create, no update section changes them -> immutable.
- CustomEmoji spaceId: optional, not immutable; update supports only name, blobId -> immutable.
draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00: VTCCall joinUri (server generates, never client-set), VTCParticipant e2eeFingerprint (media layer reports), gatewayData (create only; updates via pendingSignal).

Decision needed: change the drafts (attributes) or keep the method text as authoritative. Spec repo is out of scope for crate work.
